item.title: Build it free first: the cheapest way to find out what Apollo is worth
item.description: I built a cloud lead-enrichment tool on free tiers and made it log what every step cost. Here are the numbers, where free hurt, and the rule I'll use to decide whether a paid data plan like Apollo is worth it.
